nodes.label: Jay Dyer
nodes.desc: Central Orthobros figure and public blocker. Initiated attacks on GodLogic and Wood in May; continued through summer (icons-debate framing, GodLogic grifter claims, Aug 2–3 streams refuting GodLogic & Trent Horn). Highest centrality in the conflict network.

nodes.label: C2Antiquity

nodes.desc: Orthodox debater. Faced David Wood in the live May 13 YouTube debate 'Why Are OrthoBros Helping Jihadis?' — formal representative of the Orthobros side. Subsequently debated Mauler in a May 2026 stream hosted by JPuncut (Truth Cartel).

nodes.label: David Wood
nodes.desc: Central Wood-side figure. May 13 debate + '10 Problems with Eastern Orthodoxy' series; June Orthodoxy critique streams (incl. Schooping); July defense of GodLogic against Sam Shamoun; multi-apologist lives with GodLogic, Apostate Prophet, InspiringPhilosophy. Scheduled icons debate framing vs Dyer (reported Oct).

nodes.label: GodLogic GL
nodes.desc: Major catalyst. Past collab with Dyer, then attacked over grift accusations and aligned with Wood. Summer 2026: target of renewed Orthobros + Sam Shamoun critique; defended by Wood; subject of Dyer 'refuted' streams and C2Antiquity rebuttals.
